title: AI Music Visualizer: Turn a Song Into a Video
summary: Turn a song into a video with Flick's AI music visualizer: generate a shot for each part of your track, then cut them to the music. Start free in Flick.
body_markdown:
### What is an AI music visualizer?


An AI music visualizer is a tool that makes moving pictures for a song. Some draw abstract shapes that pulse with the audio; Flick generates filmed shots for each section of the track, which you then cut to the music.


### Does Flick make audio-reactive visualizers?


Flick makes picture shots for a song rather than bars or spectrum shapes that move with the audio. You set the timing yourself: write a timed prompt for each section, then trim each clip onto the beat on the timeline.


### Can I use my own song?


Yes. Upload the audio file to your Flick project, lay it on the timeline, and cut the generated shots to it. Use music you wrote or have the rights to.


### Can AI make the song too?


Yes. Text to Music in Flick writes an original track from a prompt with Eleven Music, where you describe the genre, the mood and the lyrics, and it runs on the Free plan.


### Is Flick's AI music visualizer free?


You can start free: you get 100 credits when you sign up and 100 credits every week, which cover Text to Music and MiniMax H3 Max video. Seedance 2.0 needs the Standard plan ($20 a month).


### How long can a music video made in Flick be?


As long as the song: each shot is a clip of a few seconds, up to 15 seconds with Seedance 2.0, and you join as many shots as the track needs on the timeline.


### Why does my AI video add its own music?


Many video models that make sound add a score by default. Write "no background music" in the shot prompt, as Catch Out, a[residency](https://flick.art/residency) short made in Flick, does to rule out music in 12 of its 29 shot prompts.
